name: yle
description: Yle (Finnish public broadcaster) News in English: search articles and Areena programs, read articles, browse latest, front-page and topic news lists, and look up video metadata.

commands.name: search
commands.summary: Keyword search across Yle articles and Areena programs, with filters for type, service, language and author

params.name: type
params.description: Restrict to one content type. Leave it out to search all types.

params.name: service
params.description: Restrict to one Yle service, e.g. 'uutiset' (news)

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip, used for paging

commands.name: get-article
commands.summary: Get an article's metadata (headline, description, publish and modify dates, keywords, author, images) from its JSON-LD

params.name: id
params.description: Article id from the yle.fi/a/<id> URL, e.g. 74-20250494

commands.name: get-article-text
commands.summary: Get an article's body text as an ordered list of paragraphs and subheadings

params.name: id
params.description: Article id from the yle.fi/a/<id> URL, e.g. 74-20215566

commands.name: list-latest
commands.summary: List the latest Yle News (English) articles, newest first

commands.name: list-front-page
commands.summary: List the stories currently on the Yle News (English) front page, with leads

commands.name: list-topic
commands.summary: List recent English articles for a topic (e.g. 18-220306 Politics, 18-34837 Domestic news, 18-204933 Economy)

params.name: topic_id
params.description: Topic id from the yle.fi/t/<id>/en URL, e.g. 18-220306 (Politics)

commands.name: get-video-preview
commands.summary: Get metadata for a Yle/Areena video program (title, series, duration, start time, HLS manifest URL)

params.name: id
params.description: Areena program id, e.g. 1-78744762 (from areena.yle.fi/1-<id> links in search results)

notes: Article ids look like 74-20250494. Search results return them as 'id', and list commands return them inside the 'url' (https://yle.fi/a/<id>).
Search: to search all content types, leave out --type. Set --type areena for Areena programs; these link to areena.yle.fi/1-<id>, and that id works with get-video-preview.
Search paging: set --offset in steps of --limit. meta.count in the raw response gives the total number of hits.
The time-range filter on the search page could not be set during exploration, so no date filter is available.
List commands (list-latest, list-front-page, list-topic) are scraped from server-rendered HTML and return only the cards visible on the first page.
For a topic page, the JSON-LD script#json-ld-microdata lists up to 40 article URLs at @graph.0.mainEntity.itemListElement.
get-video-preview responses vary by region. The manifest URL is a signed token that expires.
The 'Most popular' list and sort options exist only on the rendered page and have no API.
